definitions.full: H7452. rea I. רֵעַ verbal noun shouting, roar , but dubious; — בְּרֵעֹה֯ הָעָם קוֺל Exod 32:17 (E) sound of the people as they shouted (read Infinitive construct בָּרִעֹה for בְּהָרִיעוֺ , compare √ 5 ); רֵע֑וֺ עָלָיו יַגִּיד Job 36:33 the roar thereof telleth of him (< רַעְמוֺ his thunder , so Bu); רֵעַ תָרִיעִי לָמָּה Micah 4:9 why criest thou out with a crying? i.e. so loudly (but see √ 6 ). — II. III. רֵעַ see רעה . p. 945f
